It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分:强调主语、宾语、状语,让重点凸出来。
强调人可用 who,其余一律用 that|去掉 It is...that 句子仍完整——这是强调句的判断标准|强调状语:It was in 2019 that...|不能强调谓语;强调谓语用 do/does/did|疑问式:Was it you that...? / Who was it that...?
It was the intern who spotted the error.
column3: 正是那位实习生发现了错误。

It was on the night ferry that they first met.
column3: 他们正是在夜班渡轮上初次相遇。

It isn't the price that worries me; it's the fit.
column3: 让我担心的不是价格,是合不合身。

It was only last week that she changed her mind.
column3: 就在上周她才改的主意。

I did send the reminder — twice.
column3: 我确实发了提醒——发了两次。(do 强调)

# title: It was the recipe ___ saved the dinner.
It was ___ who broke the silence, not me.
column4: 强调句中用主格 he(后面 not me 是口语惯用补充)。

# title: ___ you that left the window open?
column4: 强调句的一般疑问式:Was it you that...?

# title: It was in the attic ___ the letters turned up.
column4: 强调地点状语用 that,不用 where。

# title: Which sentence is a cleft sentence (强调句)?
It was the coach that changed everything.|It was obvious that the coach was tired.|It was the coach who was tired that day.|It seems that the coach changed his mind.
column4: 去掉 It was...that 后 The coach changed everything 仍完整,是强调句。

# title: I ___ warn them, but they laughed.
column4: 强调过去动作的谓语用 did。
